mekayis.metin: (شَعَذَ) الشِّينُ وَالْعَيْنُ وَالذَّالُ لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ. قَالَ الْخَلِيلُ: الشَّعْوَذَةُ لَيْسَتْ مِنْ كَلَامِ أَهْلِ الْبَادِيَةِ، وَهِيَ خِفَّةٌ فِي الْيَدَيْنِ، وَأُخْذَةٌ كَالسِّحْرِ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of شَعْوَذَ (šaʕwaḏa, “to perform witchcraft”).
g: wizard, warlock, hexer (someone who claims to have supernatural powers to deceive people)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شَعْوَذَ • (šaʕwaḏa) Iq (non-past يُشَعْوِذُ (yušaʕwiḏu), verbal noun شَعْوَذَة (šaʕwaḏa))
g: to practise legerdemain or sleight of hand
to conjure, to perform magic or illusion
to make what is false assume the form of what is true
